intent: 控制路线颜色宽度和流动

params.name: routeId
params.desc: 路线 ID；省略时自建演示路线

code: const demoId = 'topology_demo_set_route_visual'; let routeId = params.routeId; if (routeId === undefined) { if (!ssp.topologyTool.getGraph(demoId)) ssp.topologyTool.createGraph({ id: demoId, layers: [{ id: 'A_1F', order: 1, elevation: 0 }, { id: 'A_2F', order: 2, elevation: 4 }], nodes: [{ id: 'entry-door', layerId: 'A_1F', position: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 }, kind: 'DOOR' }, { id: 'hydrant-a1', layerId: 'A_1F', position: { x: 4, y: 0, z: 0 }, kind: 'FACILITY', subtype: 'HYDRANT' }, { id: 'stair-a1', layerId: 'A_1F', position: { x: 8, y: 0, z: 0 }, connectorId: 'stair:north-01', kind: 'STAIR' }, { id: 'stair-a2', layerId: 'A_2F', position: { x: 8, y: 4, z: 0 }, connectorId: 'stair:north-01', kind: 'STAIR' }, { id: 'fire-a2', layerId: 'A_2F', position: { x: 12, y: 4, z: 0 }, kind: 'INCIDENT', subtype: 'FIRE' }], edges: [{ id: 'edge-entry-hydrant', source: 'entry-door', target: 'hydrant-a1', relation: 'LINK', direction: 'BIDIRECTIONAL' }, { id: 'edge-hydrant-stair-a1', source: 'hydrant-a1', target: 'stair-a1', relation: 'LINK', direction: 'BIDIRECTIONAL' }, { id: 'edge-stair-a1-a2', source: 'stair-a1', target: 'stair-a2', relation: 'CONNECTOR', direction: 'BIDIRECTIONAL', mode: 'STAIR' }, { id: 'edge-stair-a2-fire', source: 'stair-a2', target: 'fire-a2', relation: 'LINK', direction: 'BIDIRECTIONAL' }] }); const path = ssp.topologyTool.findPath({ graphId: demoId, startNodeId: 'entry-door', goalNodeId: 'fire-a2', requirements: [{ anyOfNodeIds: ['hydrant-a1'] }] }); if (!path.ok) return path; const rendered = ssp.topologyTool.renderRoute({ route: path.route }); if (!rendered.rendered) return rendered; routeId = rendered.handle.id; } const patch = params.patch === undefined ? { color: '#00E5FF', width: 0.2, opacity: 0.9, depthTest: true, flow: { active: true, speed: 2.5, spacing: 1.2, color: '#FFFFFF', size: 0.12 } } : params.patch; const updated = ssp.topologyTool.setRouteVisualState(routeId, patch); const handle = ssp.topologyTool.getRouteById(routeId); return { id: routeId, updated, found: Boolean(handle), status: handle ? handle.status : null, graphId: handle ? handle.route.graphId : null };
